counterfactual_missing_items: slowed conduction velocities, prolonged distal latencies
decisive_items: bilateral femoral nerve enlargement without enhancement
response.rationale: R1 integrates the diabetic context, marked unintentional weight loss, proximal lower-extremity lumbosacral distribution, and femoral nerve imaging into a single radiculoplexus diagnosis. R3 relies on the demyelinating EMG and elevated CSF protein but leaves the focal lumbosacral plexopathy, femoral nerve enlargement, and catabolic diabetic presentation less well explained.

rejected.why: Although the demyelinating EMG and CSF protein support CIDP, the superimposed chronic lumbosacral plexopathy and bilateral femoral nerve enlargement without enhancement are more specific to diabetic lumbosacral radiculoplexus neuropathy, especially with severe weight loss and type II diabetes.
